'''Jobs''' are tasks that the player can perform to earn [[Money]] in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]''.

==Description==
There are two types of Jobs available: [[Nightwatch]] and [[Horse Taming|Horse Breaking]]. Horse breaking is available at two locations, Nightwatch available at three. Completing a job at all five job locations contributes to [[100% Completion]]. Jobs can be repeated at each location, within time restrictions, as often as the player wants. If Marston's [[Honor]] level rises to Honest Joe or above, all jobs will pay him twice as much.

Performing jobs is required for unlocking certain [[Outfits in Redemption|outfits]].

==Horse Breaking==
[[File:StandardbredPintoWild.png|thumb|300px|John Marston taming a wild horse.]]
{{Main|Horse Taming}}

The job of Horse Breaking is the process of taming a horse to make it suitable for riding. Horse breaking can be performed at [[Ridgewood Farm]] and [[Chuparosa]].

==Nightwatch==
[[File:Protecting_a_Ranch.jpg|thumb|300px|John Marston approaching a rustler, gun readied.]]
{{Main|Nightwatch}}
Nightwatch involves patrolling a settlement and dealing with any threats that arise. Nightwatch can be performed at [[MacFarlane's Ranch]], [[Chuparosa]] and [[Blackwater]].

==Outfits==
These outfits have a scrap that requires a job to be completed:
*[[Walton's Gang Outfit]] requires completing a Horsebreaking job at [[Ridgewood Farm]].
*[[Bollard Twins Outfit]] requires completing a Nightwatch job at [[MacFarlane's Ranch]].
*[[Bandito Outfit]] requires completing a Nightwatch job in [[Chuparosa]].
*[[Reyes' Rebels Outfit]] requires completing a Horsebreaking job in [[Chuparosa]].
*[[US Army Uniform]] requires completing a Nightwatch job in [[Blackwater]].

==Tips and Tricks==

*After successfully completing Horsebreaking, the tamed horse can usually be saved by a hitching post nearby, making it the horse that comes when whistled for.
*For Nightwatch jobs, it is recommended to equip a weaker gun, such as the [[Cattleman Revolver]], to shoot offenders in the leg or arm to make it easier to [[hogtie]] them to receive the maximum amount of money for the job. Alternatively, if the [[Lasso]] has been unlocked, that will also work.
